description: This file contains unit tests for the CallLogHandler class, verifying its behavior in different scenarios such as permission checking, JSON validation, filtering, pagination, default parameters, null handling, and error management.

classes.name: CallLogHandlerTest
classes.description: A test suite for the CallLogHandler class, containing various test cases to verify its functionality.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly rejects access when permission is not granted.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Verifies that the handler properly rejects invalid JSON input.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_returnsCallLogs
methods.description: Checks that the handler returns call logs correctly when given valid JSON.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withFilters
methods.description: Tests filtering parameters like number, name, date range, duration, and type.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withPagination
methods.description: Verifies pagination logic via limit and offset parameters.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withDefaultParams
methods.description: Ensures default parameters are applied when no input is provided.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withNullFields
methods.description: Checks serialization when call log fields are null.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_clampsLimitAndOffsetBeforeSearch
methods.description: Verifies limit and offset are clamped within valid bounds before executing the search.
